name: io.github.DefectDojo/defectdojo-mcp
title: DefectDojo
description: Search, triage and import findings in DefectDojo through its REST API v2.

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your DefectDojo instance, for example https://defectdojo.example.com

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable write tools. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: true, false, or a path to a CA bundle

environmentVariables.name: DEFECTDOJO_IMPORT_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Folders that scan reports may be read from for imports
